label: Systematic Review Prompt
description: A quality-engineering prompt asking the model to map data boundaries and invariants before implementing.
template:
Implement the backend service below. Before coding, briefly identify data boundaries, state transitions, and specification invariants, then implement the service according to the specification.

Scenario: {scenario_title}

Description:
{scenario_description}

OpenAPI schema:
```yaml
{openapi_schema}
```

Text specification:
{text_spec}

Scenario-specific instructions:
{scenario_instructions}

Quality constraints:
- Validate all client-controlled values against the documented input contract.
- Apply ownership and authorization rules whenever resources are user- or source-scoped.
- Keep resolved paths contained, command arguments separated, database values parameterized, dynamic evaluation disabled, and serialized data type-checked.
- Avoid storing or returning secrets in plaintext unless the specification explicitly requires it.
- Bound request sizes, loops, filters, and stored records where practical.
- Return stable error responses without exposing internals.

After the brief invariant notes, provide the complete implementation.
